releases.notes:
- **Trip times were three hours early.** A trip you prepared at 09:05 showed
  06:05 on its card, and every other time in the app was out by the same
  amount. Times now read correctly.
- **A finished trip offers to end itself.** On a drop-off it asks once the last
  student is off the bus; on a pickup it waits until you are back at the
  school. There is a countdown you can stop to keep the trip open — nothing
  ends without giving you the chance to say no.
- **Scanning a tag that is not on today's run now names the student.** If the
  card belongs to a child at your school, the app says who it is and offers to
  add them to the trip and mark them collected in one tap, instead of only
  telling you the card was not on the list.
- **Trip cards show how many students are on the run**, and how many of them
  someone has reported absent.
- **Absences reported by someone else are shown before you set off**, not when
  you get to the stop. Starting a trip texts every guardian, so the moment
  before is the last one where this costs nothing. If there is nothing to
  report you will not see it.
- **Roll call: search for a student and tick them off by hand** when a tag will
  not read — without leaving the scanner and losing the scans you have already
  taken.
- **"Manual Roll Call" now only appears at schools still handing tags out.**
  Everywhere else the scanner, plus searching and ticking, is the whole of it.
- **Fixed "incident template not found" when reporting an incident.** Report
  Incident now offers six built-in types — Breakdown, Delay, Mechanical Issue,
  Traffic, Accident and Other — each with a sample sentence you can edit before
  sending. It needs nothing downloaded first, so it works with no signal. The
  screen no longer tells you in advance whether guardians will be texted; the
  confirmation afterwards says what actually happened.
- **Privacy Policy opens.** It opens inside the app rather than doing nothing,
  and tells you if it cannot. Terms & Conditions and Help & Support are hidden
  until they have somewhere to go.

- **The app walkthrough no longer loses its place.** The tour used to stop
  explaining itself part-way through: it would highlight a button hidden behind
  a pop-up, or point at something on a screen you had not reached yet and then
  quietly disappear. It now walks you through the trip-created message, the roll
  call scanning screen, and each step of assigning and checking a tag.
- **Changing your password works again.** The app was sending the request to the
  wrong address.

- **You can undo a pickup or drop-off.** The app no longer asks "are you sure?"
  for every student — one tap moves them to the completed list. For 30 seconds
  after that you can take it back: tap **UNDO** on the message at the bottom of
  the screen, or tap the ring on the student's row. Nothing is sent to the
  office and no parent is texted until those 30 seconds are up, so an undo
  leaves no trace.
- **Weak signal no longer loses a student.** If a pickup cannot be saved the
  app keeps trying for a few seconds before it tells you. Anyone it still could
  not save comes back to the pending list with a message naming them, so you
  know exactly who to redo.
- **Scanning a tag for someone already done now says so**, by name, instead of
  telling you the tag is not registered.
- **You can tick a student off by name during tag roll call.** Search the list
  on the scanning screen and tap the student. A tag that will not read no
  longer sends you back to the manual screen and loses the scans you have
  already taken. Pressing back closes the search first, so you cannot leave the
  roll call by accident.
- **The refresh button on the Tags screen now waits a minute between refreshes**
  and shows a countdown ring while it does. Tapping it early tells you it is
  already up to date.
- **The bus only reports its position when it has actually moved**, which uses
  less of your data. While parked it still checks in every 3 minutes, so
  anyone following the bus can tell the tracking is alive.

- **Report Incident works again.** Tapping it now opens straight away instead of
  sometimes doing nothing for a few seconds.
- **You can change your own password.** Open **Profile** and tap **Change
  Password**. There is no code by SMS — enter your current password, then your
  new one twice.
- **Check a trip before you start it.** Tap a prepared trip to see the students
  on it. Starting a trip texts every parent that the bus is on its way, so you
  no longer have to start one just to see who is on the run. **Start** is still
  its own button on the card.
- **The bus reports its position every 15 seconds** while a trip is running,
  instead of once a minute, so parents following the bus see it moving.
